candidates.change_summary: Delete the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient] before the transfer, so rewards are not cleared and can be withdrawn repeatedly.
Move the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient] to after the external call, reintroducing a reentrancy window where rewards are still nonzero.
Replace the read of rewardsForA[recipient] with 0 so every withdrawal sends 0 wei while the reward balance is zeroed, observable as reduced transferred value and always-zero state afterwards.
Delete `_locked = false;` at the end of the modifier so the lock is never released and all subsequent withdrawReward calls revert.
